title: G. C. van Spaen (Düsseldorf) to M. van der Goes, 12 and 15 Jan 1808 (NA 2.01.08 inv. 281; DECODE R1941)

steps.what: Downloaded the four DECODE R1941 images with the saved cookie; P1/P2 are one annex page photographed twice.
Transcribed all 303 code groups (letter 228, annex 75) and the clear passages.
222 distinct of 303 groups, values 15-1339; trigram 602 441 373 x3; too sparse for a ciphertext-only attack on a 1,300+ entry code.
Searched DECODE key records 1780-1815 at Dutch holders; applied Croiset's 1803 book R1035 to the annex: word salad.
Searched Colenbrander, Gedenkstukken V (1806-1810) full text for Spaen, Voorstonden, Dusseldorp, Westphalen: letters not printed.

Nationaal Archief EAD search located S.E. Croiset's cipher-office papers, NA 2.21.045 (familie Croiset) A.7.b, 1789-1810: inv. 18 correspondence with Dutch envoys on setting cipher codes, with cipher letters and code tables; inv. 21 cipher codes with notes and instructions to envoys; inv. 22 letter from W.F. Roell. All PHYSICAL, not scanned.
Brice Dudout reports the letter is dated Düsseldorf 12 Jan 1808 (No. 4); 14 Jan is the date of receipt ('Exh'); he too reads the system as a two-part code, not breakable without a crib.

outcome.method_basis: A plain numerical code of 1,300+ entries, 303 groups; no DECODE key fits (R1035 ruled out) and nothing is in print.
outcome.notes: Blocked on the key: needs the Kingdom of Holland legation code or the DECODE owner's annex reading.

credits.note: date of writing 12 Jan 1808; two-part code

prior.where: DECODE note says the 15 Jan annex was solved; no reading is published on the record

human: Selected the target; the DECODE session cookie was supplied earlier.
